fit.figure: hFE – IC, VCE = 6 V, 25 °C (page 2, by pixel; to 55 mA, past which the three temperature lines cross); IC – VBE, VCE = 6 V, 25 °C (page 2, by pixel, 10 to 190 mA; the table gives no VBE); VCE(sat) – IC, IC/IB = 10, 25 °C (page 2, by pixel; under 30 mA the three lines overlap and the band's middle is read); page 1, Cob 3.0 pF typ at VCB = 10 V, IE = 0, f = 1 MHz; page 1: fT 100 MHz typ at VCE = 6 V, IC = 1 mA
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 6 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps); no Early voltage (VAF left out): the IC – VCE figures (page 2) draw the lines flat from 1 to 10 V; no output admittance in the table, so none is set (ngspice's default). BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJC from Cobo (one point: VJC, MJC ngspice's defaults); no Cibo on the sheet, so CJE is left out. TF from fT 100 MHz at 1 mA (page 1: fT 100 MHz typ at VCE = 6 V, IC = 1 mA), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 0.5 % (hFE), 1.9 mV (VBE) and 3.5 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
fit.note: The sheet draws one typical gain line (about 300 to 314 from 1 to 45 mA at VCE 6 V), a GR-grade unit, as the BD-2's 2SC2459-GR. The VBE comes from the linear IC – VBE figure alone (no table value); on the 2SC2240's sheet the same figure reads 50 mV under the table (D-252), so a real unit's VBE may be that much higher. ISC is left free (not capped as the 2SC2240's): capped, the fit misses the VCE(sat) curve by 9 mV at 30 mA; free, it leaks 10 nA at 120 V, inside the sheet's 0.1 µA.
